svg.title: SLM-Tavenel EXP-0010 and small-model benchmark comparison
svg.desc: Six separate benchmark panels compare one selected SLM-Tavenel 1 million parameter checkpoint with an exploratory 10 million parameter checkpoint and public references. Each dot is raw accuracy; whiskers are 95 percent Wilson intervals across items and do not estimate run-to-run variation. Pythia-31M was scored only on ARC-Challenge and WinoGrande.
